name: Azure Cloud Sect Token
description: A disc of pale jade, the azure-crane sigil carved on one face. Awarded to those whose errands the sect counts as its own. Wear it and the sentries will not call for reinforcements at your back.

name: Plain Iron Sword
description: A simple straight sword of cold-hammered iron. Not yet a named blade, but it holds its edge and asks no questions.

name: Bamboo Longstaff
description: A length of seasoned bamboo fire-hardened at both ends. Light in the wrist, merciful on strangers.

name: Jade Serpent Fang Blade
description: A thin dagger forged with a bamboo-viper fang set into the spine. It breathes faintly when drawn; the edge is always a little damp.

name: Frostfang Sabre
description: A curved sabre of pale steel, edged with the fang of a frost wolf. Wounds it opens close reluctantly; the cold lingers in the flesh.

name: Azure Cloud Sword
description: A Sect-forged jian of blued steel, the fuller inlaid with a faint cloud pattern. Balanced as a scholar's brush. Disciples say the blade knows its own kind; strangers who lift it will feel no more than their own weight back.

name: Venom-Fanged Dagger
description: A short, ugly knife with two grooved edges. The grooves hold a tincture Apothecary Qi reapplies for a small fee.

name: Hempspun Traveler's Robe
description: Double-stitched hempen robe lined with thin padding. Neither elegant nor cheap.

name: Cloud Silk Robe
description: White silk woven so finely that drafts pass through it like absent thoughts. Sect-issue; stitched with the azure cloud crest.

name: Viper-Scale Sash
description: A wide sash of stitched viper scales — supple as cloth, harder to cut than most men expect. Smells very faintly of vinegar.

name: Jade Qi Pendant
description: A flat disc of river-jade threaded on a red cord. It warms slightly in the hand when its wearer is afraid.

name: Azure Guardian Talisman
description: A paper charm folded into a cloud, sealed in lacquer. It smells faintly of pine smoke.

name: Nine Serpents Ring
description: A ring of dark iron cast as nine snakes devouring each other's tails. Rumour says Matriarch Shan gives one only to those she expects to see again.

name: Monk's Wooden Beads
description: A bracelet of dark sandalwood beads worn smooth by a hundred thousand sutras. The grain is warm even in cold wind.
